_comment: The eight playable races. Stats are starting values before class bonuses; allowed_classes restricts creation and cities ties each race to its starting city.

races.name: Highlander
races.description: Hardy, adaptable folk of the Ashen Marches. They take up any calling.

races.name: Vaelith
races.description: Long-lived forest dwellers attuned to song and starlight.

races.name: Deepkin
races.description: Stout stonecarvers from under the mountains, stubborn and steadfast.

races.name: Duskborn
races.description: Grey-skinned exiles of the deep caverns, cunning and cold, gifted in the darker arts.

races.name: Hollowfolk
races.description: Small, cheerful burrow-dwellers of the river hills, quick of hand and hard to catch.

races.name: Frostmane
races.description: Tall clansfolk of the frozen north who trust steel, spirits and little else.

races.name: Morrok
races.description: Hulking swamp-born brutes with thick hide and quick healing.

races.name: Tinkerling
races.description: Tiny, endlessly curious inventors who see magic as one more machine to take apart.
